title_en: Psychology Made Simple (10/20): What's Everyone Looking At?
note_en: 明明天上什么都没有，他却觉得…一定有什么有趣的事 uses 明明…却…: 明明 stresses that a fact is plain to see, and 却 (placed after the subject, before the verb) introduces what happens in spite of it. English uses "clearly... yet" or "even though," but note that 却 can never start the clause like "but" does; it has to come after 他.
